title: The team comes first
sub: The third film of Leading a data team, the third series of Leading data people: Ubuntu, a person is a person through other people. A new data manager reads her team as a whole before judging anyone, and finds one person answering every night alert alone. The team pairs until four can answer them, and when he has to leave at a day's notice, the rota holds, and nobody calls him.
howto: The film is drawn in ink line, the look of Leading data people: whole people in the places where they live, work and meet, in flat colour with one even dark line, and the film's ideas written by hand, at a board and in notebooks. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans and design (a group's rules, the rota, a runbook), green is something done or of value (savings, an alert answered, a mistake thanked), amber a cost or a risk (one person answering every alert), orange is data, and violet only an agent.
